title: 第五章 奇异石头
content_zh:
张强等人看见李磊进去了，便也纷纷进入。

    只不过令李磊他们意外的是这门后面的空间竟如此辽阔，不，这辽阔二字已经不能用来形容这里了，这里简直就像是一个世界。

    见这门后这模样李磊等人竟燃起了一丝生的希望，因为就凭这个空间来看，打造它的人一定不是等闲之辈，如果在这里找到什么东西对李磊等人来说也许能改变现在这个窘境。

    经过一行人的探索，可结果却让他们失望透顶，这里什么都没有，准确来说整个空间除了李磊等人就没有别的东西。

    不过这里的空间却是能让受伤的人的伤口快速愈合。

    这一路以来李磊受了伤也只是简单处理，导致现在李磊的身体状况很是糟糕，只是面对之前那未知的环境他一直强忍伤痛，不肯有一丝懈怠。

    现在可好了，经历了这般周折才进入到这个地方，可到头来什么机遇，宝物什么都没有，只是给了一个疗伤的地方，李磊等人不失望才怪呢。

    此时这个空间的气氛甚是尴尬。

    过了一会张强却率先开口道“既然这里是疗伤宝地那不如首领您在这里疗伤吧，俺们出去守卫就不打扰首领您了。”

    “对对对，首领好好疗伤，我们就不打扰您了”其他人也纷纷表示赞同。

    随后张强等人转身从这个门出去了，这个空间只留下李磊一个人。

    李磊看着他们离去的身影，心里却不是滋味，只是这个情绪一闪而过，调整好心态准备疗伤。

    只不过让李磊意外的是这门竟如此特殊，从门外面看不见门里面的空间，而李磊却能从空间内看到外面的情况。

    于是李磊便准备开始疗伤，因为他已经下定决心要为他死去的那些兄弟报仇。

    只是以他现在能力面对千军万马也无可奈何。

    但至少把伤疗好了，去和孙志才一众黑衣人拼命，杀一个不亏，杀两个还赚一个，多拉几个垫背李磊还是能够做到。
content_en:
Zhang Qiang and others saw Li Lei entering, so they also entered one after another.

    But what surprised Li Lei and the others was that the space behind the door was so vast. No, the word "vast" can no longer be used to describe this place. This place is simply like a world.

    Seeing the appearance behind this door, Li Lei and others actually ignited a glimmer of hope, because judging from this space, the person who built it must not be an ordinary person. If something is found here, Li Lei and others may be able to change their current predicament.

    After a group of people explored, they were disappointed. There was nothing here. To be precise, there was nothing else in the entire space except Li Lei and others.

    However, the space here can allow the wounds of injured people to heal quickly.

    Li Lei's injuries along the way were simply dealt with, resulting in Li Lei's current physical condition being very bad. However, facing the unknown environment before, he had been enduring the pain and refused to slack off.

    It's good now. After going through so many twists and turns, I entered this place. But in the end, there was no chance and no treasures. It was just a place to heal. It would be strange for Li Lei and others not to be disappointed.

    The atmosphere in this space was very awkward at this time.

    After a while, Zhang Qiang took the lead and said, "Since this is a treasured place for healing, why don't you, leader, heal your wounds here? We won't disturb you, leader, when we go out to guard."

    "Yes, yes, leader, please heal your wounds and we won't disturb you anymore." Others also agreed.

    Then Zhang Qiang and others turned around and went out through the door, leaving only Li Lei in this space.

    Li Lei looked at their leaving figures, but he felt uncomfortable in his heart. The emotion just passed by in a flash, and he adjusted his mentality and prepared to heal.

    But what surprised Li Lei was that this door was so special. The space inside the door could not be seen from the outside, but Li Lei could see the outside situation from inside the space.

    So Li Lei was ready to start healing, because he had made up his mind to avenge his dead brothers.

    It's just that with his current ability, he can't do anything against thousands of troops.

    But at least he had healed his injuries and went to fight Sun Zhicai and the men in black. If he killed one, he would not lose, and if he killed two, he would earn one. Li Lei could still do it by pulling in a few more people to back him up.
